content:
While the Gods of the Old world cannot grant miracles or manifest signs in the New World, the faith of their followers rides with those who immigrate to it's shores. 

Riding at the bow of the Falmouth, Two ravens arrived on these shores 150 years ago. Huginn and Muninn, Thought And Memory, the Ravens of the Allfather Odin preside over the Noir.

Separate from the machinations of the Old World Gods, these creatures of living magic embody the essence by which the things we think and do become who we are. Kingsbridge is walled off from the Noir by a ring of lanterns that prevent it's magic from unraveling the borough's buildings and residents.
Positioned furthest to the east, this vast and difficult to pass through monochromatic stretch fields and hills are full of laughing voices and whispered nightmares.
As a deal with the warden Columbia, the Noir is a barrier between Empire City and the rest of the continent, making Kingsbridge the last line of defense for Arcania should Empire City fall.

This district is the origin point for all Shadow Born in empire city. When the people of Empire city pass on, it is customary to leave a precious object of theirs out in the Noir that a piece of them might live on. The magic of the borough, over time, gives them a new kind of life. The more precious the item, the more developed it will become, until eventually they become aware, and a corporeal body begins to emerge from the object itself.

Spending time in the Noir can cause you to lose color.
Losing A color has a specific effect on your character. You cannot regain color with out spending the night outside in Hampstead proper.

1. **Losing Red** ensures that you cannot heal  past 50% of your total hp.
2.**Losing Blue** causes you begin petrifying into black and white marble.  Attack rolls against you have advantage.
The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
The creature has Resistance to all damage.
The creature is immune to poison and disease, although a poison or disease already in its system is suspended, not neutralized.
3.**Losing Green**
Causes you to begin shaking and fumbling.
When you miss on an attack:, you drop your weapon or item in your hand. This includes component pouches and arcane focuses. When in combat, you start every round prone. It will cost you half movement to stand. At the end of your turn you will once again fall prone.
4.**Losing Yellow.**
Causes your body to begin sweating.
The creature is overcome with fever and cannot take bonus actions or reactions.
It has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws and checks and attack rolls that use either ability.
Losing 3 colors results in a loss of all hp.
